That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: data engineering & pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture & migration, real-time streaming & event-driven decisioning — delivered on Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: LMS, SIS, attendance and support-service data never meet; at-risk students surface at failure, not at drift.
